Full Throttle Heel.name: Full Throttle Heel
Full Throttle Heel.description: The user commits to a twenty-meter overdrive run and delivers one engine-driven heel strike this turn for heavy bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user brakes before contact and sweeps the opponent's legs with reduced force. A clear approach is essential, and afterward both engines stall until the end of the user's following turn, leaving ordinary movement only. Strain: severe.
